requirement: Requirement history begins: everything in the suite at 0.1.0 is the baseline. The suite derives from research_skills 0.9.1 (isitcredible/research_skills@766f28f); upstream requirement rows R001-R533 are not carried over, and a run made with the upstream suite is not a stats-review run.

The synthesis header counts the rows of its own statement-ledger table by Holds, after any moves; a row whose rating differs from the statements stage's names the evidence it turns on, with its path, in the row.
note: The verdict gate compared the header with the statements-stage ledger and failed every legitimate move (demo run, 3 November 2026).

requirement: REVIEW comments in the annotated source carry the issue's label in the form (Major 2, Minor 1); the org form numbers issues the same way.
note: The annotated source numbered issues in ledger order while the form numbers Major and Minor issues separately.

requirement: Depth quick runs two agents: a review agent for document, code-and-data and statements (each with its report and gate) and a fresh verdict agent that writes SYNTHESIS.md and compiles the consistency review; the form's verify pass runs in a fresh context.
note: Two demo runs took 8 to about 15 agents and 1.6 to 3.4 hours of model time for a two-page SSE.

requirement: For a short product (at most 10 rendered pages) the code-and-data agent works through each fired module itself and writes its report; for a long product fired modules run as their own agents, one at a time.

Proportion: stage, module and challenge reports and SYNTHESIS.md stay within word limits set by the product's size class (short: 1,500, 600, 1,500 and 3,000); the gates fail above 1.25 times a limit; a short product's statement ledger keeps at most 15 rows.
note: The demo runs wrote 9,000 to 12,700 words of synthesis for an 819-word source.

requirement: The form's general comments, issues and answers stay within about 1,000 words for a short product and 3,000 for a long one; the coverage gate fails above 1.25 times the limit.
note: The demo runs' forms ran to 2,600 to 2,900 words.

requirement: Agents carry tool-call budgets by size class; the coordinator never re-runs a stage's scripts or re-decides a ruling; recomputation is analytic first, simulating only to confirm; never two reviews at once on one account.
note: The demo run's coordinator re-ran six challenge scripts and its context reached 222k tokens.

requirement: The form ends with "Evidence behind each issue": per issue, links to the files in its sources: field that exist in the job and are committed with it; never a copy of the product, its documents, literature or data.

The render writes REVIEWER.md (where the human reviewer starts) and, once, DISPOSITIONS.md (the reviewer's decision on each issue: kept, edited or dropped, with a reason); check_dispositions.py checks it and counts the decisions.

Working with the reviewer on a finished review: the run's data rules still bind; answers cite the job's evidence; variants re-run in work/followup/; the form, ISSUES.md and SYNTHESIS.md change only at the reviewer's request; decisions are recorded only as the reviewer states them.

A job lives beside the product in the product's own repository and is committed there under the .gitignore new_job.py writes (no copies of the product or its documents, no literature, no data); in data mode shared the intake gate (I2) requires the shared-mode block that keeps the work files out.

Before the run: the operating rules (where the job lives, clearance first, one confirmation with depth, data mode, size class and usage, the billing check, never two reviews at once) are part of the skill, so they bind wherever it runs.

The skills are renamed so they read well outside DKF: dkf-review is stats-review, dkf-review-audit is stats-review-audit, dkf-consistency-review is stats-consistency-review, dkf-synthetic-data is stats-synthetic-data, and the chat skill dkf-document-check is stats-document-check; what a run, audit or consistency review must do is unchanged.
note: Jobs made with 0.3.1 or earlier name the old skill folders in their instructions; read dkf-<name> as stats-<name>.
